desc: Parse input and compute nxt[x], gap[x] via two-pointer scan over sorted A.
Build a sparse table over gap for range maximum queries on [L,t].
Implement validity check for query [L,R] and candidate t: range_max(L,t) + t <= R.
For each query, binary-search the largest valid t in [L, floor((L+R-1)/2)], output t-L+1 or 0.
Test on sample inputs and edge cases: duplicates, length-2 intervals, impossible pair, max constraints.
